王野把十多个盒子放进背篓里，看着翟老头就不出门，就这么盯着他，过了没一分钟，翟老头就被盯麻了，没好气的说道：“别看了，看也没有了。”

王野可不信他，用后世的说法，这糟老头子，坏的很。就不说话，死死的盯着他。翟老头被逼的没办法了：“我是有支百年的棒槌，但是我不卖。”

王野知道自己的目的达到了，从翟老头一次拿出十支三十年的王野就猜到这老头手里有大货，先是炸出来了两支五十年的，王野就想试试还有没有更好的，谁知道这老头还真有。

王野一脸奸笑：“大爷，用你们东北话说，这事儿咱得唠唠了，我就问你一句，你这宝贝村里有人知道吗？”

翟老头想了一下：“有几个，怎么了？”

王野：“大爷，你是真心大呀，还有几个，咱做个假设，这宝贝儿要是放在三十年前会怎么样？”

翟老头瞥了一眼王野：“那能怎么样，上交呗，要不会死人的。”

王野知道鱼上钩了：“那大爷，我再问你一个问题，你觉得你们这儿公社的人靠谱吗？”

这话一说翟老头脑门儿上汗都出来了，这可不是王野危言耸听吓唬翟老头，就他们这儿，公社的人隔三差五来打秋风，王野就断定这帮人不是什么好鸟。

翟老头心有不甘的说：“这东西是可以传家的宝贝，卖了我不甘心呀。”

王野心平气和跟翟老头解释道：“大爷，能传下去是传家的宝贝，传不下去那就是祸根。大爷，还想问问你，你家就你自己吗？家里的孩子呢？”

翟老头叹了口气说：“还有俩孙子，其他人倭寇来的时候都没了，现在俩孙子都在林场。”

王野：“正式工？”

翟老头：“啥正式工呀，就是零工。”

王野知道收杆的时候到了：“大爷，你说两个正式的工作能不能传家。”

这时代正式工作那真是铁饭碗，是可以一代传一代的。翟老头眼睛都亮了，王野继续说：“大爷，你们这个地方，一个正式工的名额应该超不过300块钱吧，我给你个一口价600，你考虑考虑。”

王野看出了翟老头内心的挣扎，拿出烟，递给翟老头一根儿，自己点了一根儿。抽了一口又说道：“大爷我先说好，这个价就是最后的价儿，不商量，你要是同意我掏钱，你要是不同意，咱买卖不成仁义在。”

翟老头就在那里低着头抽着烟，没一会儿一根儿烟就抽完了，王野又拿出一根儿递给他，就这样抽完第三根儿烟，翟老头狠狠的把烟头往地上一扔：“卖了，你说的对，不是有句话说，怀里有宝贝就是罪吗。”

王野纠正道：“是怀璧其罪”。

翟老头：“爱璧不璧，给了你就是你的事儿了。

王野心里都乐开花了，百年的人参王野有，还不少，足足有七支，但是这东西谁会嫌少呀。就算是空间可以种，先不说药用效果是不是和野山参一样，就算一样也得等十年。

翟老头进小屋拿出了一个大盒子，小心翼翼的放在炕上，打开盖子对王野努了努嘴。王野赶紧凑了上去，仔仔细细的开始观察，没一会儿王野盖上盒盖，从包里拿出600块钱递给翟老头。

老头这次只数了两遍，就把钱收起来了。王野想起了一件事，这翟老头是个猎人不知道有没有虎骨，便开口问道：“大爷，你有虎骨吗？”

Wang Ye put more than ten boxes into his backpack and watched Old Man Zhai not going out, just staring at him. Within a minute, Old Man Zhai was stared at and said angrily: "Stop looking, there's nothing left to look at."

Wang Ye didn't believe him. In later generations' terms, this bad old man was very bad.He said nothing and stared at him.Old Man Zhai was forced to do nothing: "I have a century-old mallet, but I won't sell it."

Wang Ye knew that his goal had been achieved. From the fact that old man Zhai took out ten thirty-year-old ones at a time, Wang Ye guessed that the old man had something big in his hands. He first exploded two fifty-year-old ones. Wang Ye wanted to see if there were any better ones. Who knew that the old man really had them.

Wang Ye smiled evilly: "Uncle, in your Northeastern dialect, we have to talk about this matter. Let me ask you, does anyone in your precious village know about it?"

Old Man Zhai thought for a moment: "How many are there? What's wrong?"

Wang Ye: "Uncle, you are really generous. There are a few more. Let's make a hypothesis. What would have happened to this baby thirty years ago?"

Old Man Zhai glanced at Wang Ye: "What can I do? Just hand it over, or someone will die."

Wang Ye knew that the fish was hooked: "Uncle, let me ask you another question. Do you think the people in your commune are reliable?"

As soon as he said this, old man Zhai was sweating on his forehead. This was not Wang Ye's scaremongering to scare old man Zhai. In their place, people from the commune came to fight against the autumn wind every now and then, so Wang Ye concluded that these people were not good birds.

Old Man Zhai said unwillingly: "This thing is a treasure that can be passed down from family to family. I won't be willing to sell it."

Wang Zhiye calmly explained to Old Man Zhai: "Uncle, if it can be passed down, it is a family heirloom. If it cannot be passed on, it will be a curse. Uncle, I also want to ask you, is it just you in your family? Where are the children at home?"

Old Man Zhai sighed and said, "I still have two grandsons. The others were gone when the Japanese pirates came. Now both grandsons are in the forest farm."

Wang Ye: "Regular job?"

Old Man Zhai: "It's not a formal job, it's just a part-time job."

Wang Ye knew that it was time to close up: "Uncle, do you think two formal jobs can be passed down to the family?"

In this era, formal jobs are really an iron rice bowl and can be passed down from one generation to the next.Old Man Zhai's eyes lit up. Wang Ye continued: "Uncle, in your place, the quota for a formal worker should not exceed 300 yuan. I will give you a fixed price of 600 yuan. You can consider it."

Wang Ye saw the inner struggle of Old Man Zhai, took out a cigarette, handed one to Old Man Zhai, and lit one himself.He took a sip and then said: "Sir, let me agree first. This price is the final price. There is no negotiation. If you agree, I will pay. If you don't agree, our business will not be done."

Old Man Zhai was smoking a cigarette with his head lowered. After a while, he finished all the cigarettes. Wang Ye took out another cigarette and handed it to him. After smoking the third cigarette, Old Man Zhai threw the cigarette butt to the ground: "Sell it. You are right. Isn't there a saying that it is a sin to have a baby in your arms."

Wang Ye corrected him: "It is his crime to have a jade in his arms."

Old Man Zhai: "If you like the jade or not, it's your business to give it to you.

Wang Ye was filled with joy. There were quite a lot of century-old ginseng in Wang Ye, with seven branches in total. But who would be too little of this thing?Even if it can be grown in space, let’s not talk about whether the medicinal effect is the same as that of wild ginseng. Even if it is the same, it will still take ten years.

Old man Zhai went into the hut and took out a big box, carefully placed it on the kang, opened the lid and nuzzled at Wang Ye.Wang Ye quickly stepped forward and began to observe carefully. After a while, Wang Ye closed the lid of the box, took out 600 yuan from his bag and handed it to Old Man Zhai.

The old man only counted it twice this time and then put the money away.Wang Ye remembered something. This old man Zhai was a hunter and didn't know if he had tiger bones, so he asked: "Uncle, do you have tiger bones?""
